Keep persisted execution branch names exact

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-25
  description: |-
    Recovery adopted a sibling Issue-linked Git ref when the persisted name was missing. Validate that persisted name exactly and fail closed instead of substituting. Cover the missing-persisted cases plus preflight prefix-first discovery, Workspace-key fallback, both/neither, and commit-mismatch rejection without sibling fallback.
